title: Introducing Mastra Studio-scoped SSO
summary: Sign in to Mastra Studio with WorkOS, Okta, Auth0, Clerk, or Google.
body_markdown:
You can now[bring your own auth](https://mastra.ai/docs/mastra-platform/studio#bring-your-own-auth) to Mastra Studio, letting your team sign in using a preferred SSO provider. Support includes WorkOS, Okta, Auth0, Clerk, and Google.


Often teams want to separate out auth for Mastra’s server vs Studio, where external users of the agent have access to the server, but team members have access to Studio. Now, you can do that easier.


Your browser does not support the video tag.


Previously, you could configure SSO on the server, and Studio would inherit it, but there was no separate SSO permissioning available for the Studio.


Set` MASTRA_PLATFORM_STUDIO_AUTH=disabled` to replace the default platform sign-in with your` studio.auth` provider. Disabling platform sign-in without configuring` studio.auth` or` server.auth` leaves Studio publicly accessible.


## Auth matrix


How each combination of settings protects Studio on Mastra platform:


` MASTRA_PLATFORM_STUDIO_AUTH`` studio.auth`` server.auth` Studio login


not set any any Platform sign-in


` disabled` set any` studio.auth`


` disabled` not set set` server.auth`


` disabled` not set not set None (public)


## Get started


Install an auth provider package. This example uses WorkOS:


Terminal


```text
npm   install   @mastra/auth-workos@latest
```


note


Requires` @mastra/core@1.42.0` or later, added in[PR #17722](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/17722) .


Add the provider to` studio.auth` in your Mastra config.` server.auth` stays separate and protects your server endpoints:


src/mastra/index.ts


```text
import   {   Mastra   }   from   "  @mastra/core/mastra  "  ;
import   {   MastraAuthWorkos   }   from   "  @mastra/auth-workos  "  ;


export   const   mastra   =   new   Mastra  ({
server: {
auth:   /* ... */
},
studio: {
auth:   new   MastraAuthWorkos  ()
},
// ...
});
```


Add the provider credentials and disable platform auth in your` .env` :


.env


```text
WORKOS_API_KEY  =
WORKOS_CLIENT_ID  =
WORKOS_REDIRECT_URI  =
WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD  =
MASTRA_PLATFORM_STUDIO_AUTH  =  disabled
```


For more information and full configuration options, see:


- [Bring your own auth](https://mastra.ai/docs/mastra-platform/studio#bring-your-own-auth)
- [Studio auth](https://mastra.ai/docs/studio/auth)
- [Auth overview](https://mastra.ai/docs/auth/overview)
- [WorkOS](https://mastra.ai/integrations/auth/workos)
- [mastra deploy](https://mastra.ai/reference/cli/mastra#mastra-deploy)
